lines.en: When we finally make it to the beach, Imani quickly takes roll call to see which of us are still missing since some of the girls weren’t able to make it onto the bus on time.
Thankfully, one of the girls who is currently missing is Wakana.

So, at the very least, I’ll remain alive until she gets here and follows through on her apparent need to kill me for what I will ultimately simplify as writer’s block in order to avoid a more depressing explanation.
It’s not that I didn’t want to write something. I just couldn’t.
You see, in my opinion, it’s fine for characters to grow or develop.
It’s fine for people to look back on things they’ve done in the past and learn to move forward without being dragged down by them.
But it’s also fine to not do that.

It’s fine to remain the same piece of shit you have always been because you know that moving forward and growing should be for those of us who don’t hide our worries in the fleshy depths of developing bodies.
It is fine to spend these hateful summer days entranced by the same things you once thought that you don’t want to think anymore because you have learned how to think of other things to think about.
And you’re a good guy. You are. But you’re also bad. You’re evil. And your mind is pulling you in so many directions that figuring out which one to go in becomes impossible.
You become the rope.
And when you snap, everyone loses.
It’s hard to breathe again.
And so, so hot.
Everyone eventually shows up and I don’t have to think anymore.
The first point goes to me.
: Alright, bitches and hoes! And also Molly!
: Why do you always- oh. Wait. I think it was good that I was excluded this time. Carry on.
: Now that we’ve all gathered here, it’s time to begin the third annual Dorm Wars! Kind of!
: Kind of?

: Seeing as we didn’t want our entire beach trip to be overly-competitive, Uta and I have decided that the best way to ensure at least some level of relaxation is to push back the first contest until later tonight.

: With the one notable exception being the brand new, confusing two-part contest Makoto came up with. That will begin as soon as she’s done explaining the rules. So maybe sometime next week if we’re lucky.
: It’s really not as confusing as Uta is making it sound. The whole idea is to just prevent Sensei from being touched which, let’s face it...pretty much all of you do every single day anyway.
: Additionally, it will not begin as soon as my explanation ends as we should give our teams at least a few minutes to prepare first.
: Regardless, since all of you spend so much time fighting over Sensei, I thought...why not make a competition out of it?
: Especially since the girls of the first floor have way more experience roadblocking physical contact with Sensei than the ones on the floor above us.
: I wouldn’t be so sure about that, Makoto. If anybody’s good at roadblocking physical contact, it’s good ole Room #7. That’s basically our whole thing.
: Is it? I could have sworn your room’s thing was just being short and annoying.
: You think I’m annoying?
: Well, when you go calling the contest I spent a whole night coming up with “weird and confusing,” it’s kind of hard to not get annoyed-
: Makoto. Rules, please. I would like to go relax now.
: And I would like to continue not giving a shit, but in a slightly more informed way.
: Fine. The simplest way of putting it is that Noriko and Maya have to try and hug Sensei. And it’s up to Yumi and Tsuneyo to make sure that doesn’t happen.
: If it does, the team that made the hug gets two points and the team that doesn’t gets nothing.
: What if, in some crazy turn of events, Maya and I manage to hug Sensei at the exact same time and it’s like, some big emotional climax thing?
: Then I burst into flames and all three of us die. The end.
: In the event of Maya, Noriko, and Sensei dying, the points will simply cancel out.
: Can we please be a little more concerned about my make-believe death?
: Can we please be a little more concerned about people other than me hugging my uncle?
: No and no. Any other questions?
: Yeah. Is it too late to switch classes?
: You’ll have to ask Miss Watabe when she gets here.
: How the fuck am I supposed to do that when I’ve gotta apparently spend the whole ass weekend beating the shit out of Pinkie?
: Please don’t beat anyone. And it’s not the whole weekend. It’s just until one of them succeeds in hugging him.
: Well then Ponytail better hurry the fuck up because if I need to babysit our pervert teacher for the next two nights, I’m just going to drown myself.
: You know, I’m really happy you’re finally participating, but I do wish you’d be a little happier about it.
: And I wish you didn’t offer me half of your next paycheck if I can win us this stupid fucking contest. Offer was too good to pass up.
: If there are no further questions, I’ll leave the rest of today’s pre-war explanation and scheduling talk up to Uta.
: Two contests later tonight, everything else tomorrow, and a brand new pillow-fight tradition in the second floor’s room starting at midnight. Underwear only and no boys allowed.
: Oh, great. Now I have to find somewhere else to sleep. That always goes really well for me.
: On the bright side, looks like me and you probably won’t have to do stuff until tomorrow! Can’t imagine Makoto’s gonna let me use a hammer in the dark.
: You’re really still going to try? Even though you know I’m going to beat you?
: Yeah. Ain’t no harm in competin’ just because you know somebody else has got the upper hand. There are tons of underdog stories in sports. Maybe I’ll make history tomorrow or somethin’?
: Woodworking and construction aren’t really sports, though. And while they’re also not as difficult as most people make them out to be, they’re not really a thing you can just pick up on right away.
: Idunno. Lotta people say the same thing about soccer but I picked up on that right away.
: Well, good luck kicking a raft together, I guess.
: Is that actually an option?
: What? No. That was...
: Have you ever heard of a “joke” before? Because that was one of those.
: I don’t get it. Ain’t jokes supposed to be, like...funny?
: Are you mocking me right now?
: Are you mocking me right now? Cause it kinda sounded like you were, Io.
: I know I might not be the brightest tool in the shed, but even I get offended when people don’t take me seriously in contests.
: You know it’s the sharpest tool in the shed, right?
: Like I said, I ain’t the sharpest crayon in the box! Just stop underestimatin’ me before we’ve even started.

: That’s not really what I’m trying to do. I mean, it is kind of what I’m doing, yeah...but that’s only because I don’t get the rationale behind trying something you pretty much know you’re going to fail at.
: Well, I think it’s like...expectin’ to fail is the problem in the first place.
: I think anybody’s capable of anything so long as they try their hardest. So there ain’t no challenge I’d back away from before I even give it an attempt, you know?
: Wow. People without extreme social anxiety sure have an interesting way of looking at things.
: That was a nice motivational speech and all, but I’ll probably just keep avoiding all of the things I know I suck at. You do you, though.
: I will! And don’t even think of takin’ it easy on me tomorrow cause I can tell when somebody ain’t givin’ it their all.
: Okay, but...again. You have absolutely no chance and I wouldn’t hold it against you if you gave up now and saved yourself the splinters.
: Splinter was my favorite ninja turtle. I got this.
: Splinter was a rat.
: What? Then who was the one with the staff?
: Donatello. And don’t ask me why I know this.
: Why do you know this?
: Does literally anything anyone says to you register or do you just live in your own world all the time?
: You want pizza, Io? Because I kinda want pizza now.
: Hah...This is a whole new level of “hard to talk to” that even I’m struggling to properly grasp.
: Anxious about your contest at all? Still planning on using the same strategy you told me about last night?
: You mean nervously throwing a bunch of ingredients together and hoping that whatever comes out on the other side is edible? Yeah. After a lot of thought, I think that’s how I’m gonna handle things.
: How about you, though? Don’t you feel a little weird coming up with a confession speech when you’re already in a relationship?
: I mean...it’s just writing at the end of the day. People write all sorts of things all the time and it doesn’t mean they actually feel them, you know?
: It’s just kind of like...tapping into somebody else’s feelings...or something. It’s not really a big deal.
: I wish I could think of it that way. I’ve always...found separating myself from writing to be kind of hard.
: Even with my contest, I’m having a hard time figuring out how I’m going to tackle things. And it definitely doesn’t help that I’ll be competing with Nodoka of all people.
: Don’t sell yourself short, Futaba. You’re extremely talented and I am extremely unmotivated right now. In my current state, you have a real shot at beating me.
: Well, at least you’re honest enough to admit that I couldn’t beat you under normal circumstances.
: I kind of hope you do, though. Nodoka needs somebody to humble her and it seems like everyone else is just food for her ego most of the time.
: Did you hear that, Futaba? Otoha thinks I’m going to eat you.
: I think you’d eat literally anyone if presented the opportunity. Both sexually and not sexually. And Futaba is definitely no exception to that based on how close you are to her right now.
: You...are a little close, Nodoka.
: I know. Isn’t it great?
: It...can’t be helped, I suppose...
: Wow. You really just let her do whatever she wants with you, huh?
: Oh, Rin. If that were true, do you really think our clothes would be on right now?
: In a public space? I sure hope so.
: She’s been like this forever, Rin. There’s no point in trying to change her this late in life.
: I mean...as long as you’re okay with it, that’s cool. She’s just a different level of clingy with you that makes me feel like there’s more to it than just-
: You’re just jealous because Otoha doesn’t hold you the way I hold Futaba.
: That’s not true at all! Her hand is like, totally on my shoulder right now! And that’s not even counting the things we do when-
: Shh. No words. Bad Rin.
: Otoha, grab my boob. Show Nodoka you mean just as much business as she does.
: What? No. We’re surrounded by a million other girls and Nodoka will just use it as an excuse to grope Futaba.
: As if I need an excuse to grope the breasts I watched develop.
: Just grab them, Otoha. It’s above the clothes so it’s fine and normal.
: Rin, I’m not groping you in public.
: Fine. Then I’m just going to assume you don’t love me anymore.
: Uh-huh. That’s exactly what that means.
: Even sexually active, you two remain weak. Futaba and I will show you what real love looks like later tonight.
: We will not.
: She says, unaware that she is mere hours away from realizing I am the woman of her dreams.
: Nodoka, no. But if my sexual preference suddenly changes, I’ll make sure to tell you first.
: What?! Even before me?! What kind of betrayal is this, Futaba?!
: To think we’re just one friend away from nightly orgies...how sad.
: Yeah! Get with the program, Futaba!
: Rin. Come on.
: What? It wouldn’t be the first time we- wait. Nope. Futaba doesn’t know about that.
: Hm? Know about what?
: It sounds to me like these two may have had some sort of encounter with a second couple. I wonder who it could have been?
: I doubt it. Rin would have- wait. Where did Rin go?
: Run, Otoha! Before I reveal more confidential information!
: Wait! Rin! Your bag is still over there!
: I’ll get a new one!
: Huh...I wonder what sort of battle Nithhala and the succubus are fleeing from.
: You still refer to her as “the succubus” despite having moved past your issues with her?
: Name changes are a microtransaction I am not willing to splurge for, Kendo Princess. She’ll remain “the succubus” forever regardless of my feelings toward her.
: You should stop feeling things altogether. Freeing yourself from human emotion will make you a better chef and bring us one step closer to sleeping at an adult male’s house. Hoo-rah.
: What is with you and the “hoo-rahs” lately? And more importantly than that, what is with this seductive pose? Because I’ll have you know I am not immune to charm just because you’re my best friend.
: It just felt like the right thing to do.
: Well, it’s making me feel much less significant as a woman, so thank you for that.
: A woman is more than just her body, Emerald Guardian. Your undeveloped chest and petite frame make you no less feminine than me.
: Easy for you to say when you’re out here with the body of a grown woman and I’m still a sack of russet potatoes.
: Potatoes taste better than women. And you should be focusing more on that for now as your contest is merely a day away and you have done no practicing whatsoever.
: But how am I supposed to focus on something like cooking when Baldur’s Gate 3 is finally out of early access?! Do you have any idea how long I’ve waited for Act 2?!
: Besides, Rin hasn’t been practicing either! She’s too busy getting succubus’ed!
: Look at my body, Emerald Guardian.
: I can’t stop looking at it! Just what in Neit’s name did your father feed you when you were younger?!
: Delicious food made with love and pork fat. Food that I have been trying to teach you how to cook since the announcement of your contest, but you would rather lay around and waste the days away.
: How many more bars of rested experience do you require before you finally make an effort to level up, Emerald Guardian?
: Can’t I just order something and...have a rogue sneak it into the contest to make it look like I was the one who crafted it?
: Delivery?...
: I don’t even know who you are anymore...

: Mngh...this sucks. I have to be outside and learn how to cook? This isn’t what I signed up for. The gods of the Dorm Wars are supposed to gift me contests I have a chance to win. At least you have a shot at yours.
: You'd have a shot as well if you would only heed my warning. Now, please remain silent so I can continue being the most attractive woman here.
: And stop staring at me. You have relinquished that right.
: Ugh. Since when can you detect thoughts?
: Yumi, how do my boobs look?
: Uhh...like boobs? How the fuck am I supposed to answer that?
: Do they look good or bad? It’s not rocket science.
: Chika, you know I don’t swing that way, right?
: Bitch, you don’t need to be a fucking lesbian to tell your best friend she’s got a nice rack!
: I’ve got a contest tonight that I have to look hot for. Hotter than normal. Way hotter than normal. So hot that it’s a fucking crime.
: Now swallow your dated-ass straight pride and fucking compliment my tits, you stupid whore.
: Jeez, fine. Yeah. They’re...they’re boobs alright.
: Hah...thank you. Was that really so hard?
: Well, forgive me for not wanting to fuck you.
: It doesn’t matter if you want to fuck me. What’s important is that Sensei wants to fuck me because that is what will earn our team a point.
: Well, if that’s the issue, I’m pretty sure you don’t have to worry because that dude would probably fuck anything he could fit his gross ass dick inside.
: It’s not gross. It’s big and it’s hot.
: Aaaaand I’m gonna puke.
: No you’re not, shut up. And the thing you said is exactly the problem. Sensei obviously wants to fuck me, but Uta is tough competition and he’d be insane if he didn’t want to fuck her too.
: That girl is cute and hot. Which means I have to go hard on the hot aspect and really outdo her in that area if I want a shot at this.
: Then just flash your tits during the competition or something. That’ll get him, right?
: In front of the whole class? Are you trying to get me jumped? Plus, I want to win this thing fair and square and flashing him isn’t the way to do that.
: Also, if Uta responded and flashed him too, I’d be done for. That girl is like a foot shorter than me and still has bigger boobs. It’s unfair and I want them.
: Are tits like, all you think about?
: Sometimes, yeah.
: Oh, there’s Ayane. I’ll ask her.
: Ayane! Come with me for a sec! I’ve got a question for you!
: Why is everybody in this class so fucking weird?...
: Ayane! How do my boobs look?!
: Why is everybody in this class so fucking weird?...
: Uhh...
: What’s going on here?
: I need to know that I look hot so I can beat Uta in the gravure contest and Yumi’s too much of a straight bitch to tell me I look good.
: You know I’m straight too, right?
: Really? I could have sworn you were bi.
: Nope.
: Chika...
: Are you...trying to pick me up right now?
: What? No. Hold on. That’s...no. I actually have a boyfriend.
: So you just...have your arm around me because you want me to tell you that your boobs are nice?
: That would definitely make me feel better, yes.
: Yeah, they’re nice.
: Thank you. I appreciate that.
: B or C?
: You beat me by one letter.
: Keep your chin up. I’m a little older than you, so you’ve still got time.
: Thanks. I’m glad we were able to have this talk.
: Same. Thanks again for your help.
: There’s something else, isn’t there?
: Yeah, there’s something else.
: It’s just a...sensitive topic, so I’m just trying to think of the right way to ask.
: Can you, like...
: If I tell you something in strict confidentiality...and I mean strict...can you keep it a secret?

: That depends. Are you going to tell me that one of the girls in class is secretly a murderer and that she’s killed all of us in different versions of this timeline? Because I’m fully booked up on secrets like that.
: That’s...not even remotely close to what I was going to tell you. And it’s a really weird first assumption.
: Yeah, well...weird things seem to just follow me around all the time now. So I’m sure whatever it is you’re about to ask me is just one more for the pile.
: Okay, but...again, this is like...super confidential. And I mean super confidential. And if anyone finds out, I’m coming to you first.
: Is that a threat?
: I suppose you could call it that. But you’ll understand once you hear it.
: Wonderful.
: As fair warning, though...it might upset you since it involves someone you’re close to.
: Par for the course. Please proceed.
: Well, uhh...let’s see here...
: God, this is embarrassing...
: So, umm...
: So...you know that...boyfriend I mentioned a couple minutes ago?
: So, like...
: Fuck. This is so embarrassing.
: Yeah, you mentioned that already.

: So like...my boyfriend...is super amazing. And he’s always doing amazing stuff for me, and...I’ve been thinking of ways to do something special for him to kind of, like...say thanks for all of that.
: And we were talking and...I brought up the idea that maybe...we could, like...
: You know...
: Maybe...have a threesome?
: And you...came to me about this? We barely even know each other.
: Well...you see...my boyfriend is actually...
: It’s actually...Sensei...
: And he’s the one who...suggested you...
: This was his idea?...
: Well, no. The threesome was my idea...
: But he’s the one who said it should be with me?...
: You’re upset, aren’t you?...
: I am...a lot of things right now.

: I know it’s probably hard finding out that the guy you like is dating somebody else...but if you didn’t hold a special place in Sensei’s heart, he wouldn’t have suggested you. So you can be happy about that.
: Yeah...I’m over the moon.
: Ayane, I know this is, like...a really weird thing to ask. And I also know that you’ve probably never done anything sexual before, so this is all coming out of left field and...probably scary.
: But if you’re okay with it, I promise to do everything I can to make you comfortable. And it might be the only chance you get to be with Sensei at this rate since he and I are really serious.
: Are you?
: Yeah...
: How serious?
: Like...we’re totally committed to each other.
: Do you want to start a family with him?
: Do you want to have his kids?
: Do you even know the first thing about him?

: Ayane, I’m not looking to have an in-depth conversation about the specifics of my relationship. I’m just trying to do something nice for my boyfriend and was wondering if you’d be interested. That’s all.
: Oh, I’m interested. I’m very interested.
: You...You are?...
: Yeah. I can’t wait to experience what might be the only chance I ever have to “get close” to Sensei. I’m sure it will be really...really...really...really special.
: You’re sure? Like...100%% sure?...
: Yeah. I can’t wait.
: And you’re not just fucking with me, right? Because if you’re fucking with me-
: Call him over right now. Let’s do it.

: N-Now?!...No way...I’ve gotta like...mentally prepare myself first. I’ve never done anything with another girl before. And we’ve still gotta, like...set limits and stuff. Right? Isn’t that how this works?
: How should I know? You’re the one who invited me. I’m just here to have what will be my first sexual experience ever. Boy, am I raring to go.
: Y...Yeah. I...I bet you are...Hahah...
: So, uhh...hahah...I guess I’ll just...give you a call when...I have stuff figured out...
: Sounds good, Chika. I’ll be looking forward to sharing the man I love with you. I’m sure it’ll be a blast.
: Hahah...hah...
: I’m gonna...
: I’m gonna...go meet back up with Yumi...
: I’ll be waiting.
: Uh-huh! See you, Ayane! And remember...secret!
: Mhm.
